name: Rockport 2026 Authentic Measured Handling & Pursuit Polish (v2.4)
description: Small, measured nudges that keep the 2005 NFSMW feel: a slightly more linear analog curve for modern sticks, a touch more turn-in on the hero BMW M3 GTR and the career Corvette, and a little more pressure in cop spawn pacing. Handling deltas stay within +/-5% and pursuit deltas within +/-10% of stock (budget enforced by tools/verify_v24_vlt_and_saves.py). No grip, brake, NOS, traffic or patrol-count changes. Use instead of modern_handling_tuning + pursuit_and_traffic, not stacked with them.

patches.note: Slightly more linear analog response for DualSense sticks while keeping the stock centre feel (-4%)
Hero BMW M3 GTR: a little more turn-in (+4.4%), still the softest steering in the roster
Hero BMW M3 GTR: slightly quicker yaw settle (+4%)
Prologue BMW M3 GTR: matching yaw settle (+3.8%)
Corvette C6: marginally crisper direction changes (+3.3%)
Heat 1: cop reinforcements arrive 0.5 s sooner (-5%)
Heat 2: cop reinforcements arrive 0.5 s sooner (-5%)
Heat 4: cop reinforcements arrive 0.25 s sooner (-5%)
